answer: The pewter shop glows with the furnace heat, and the moulds stand cooling on the shelf. Proof of pewterer via mould pour tally — a plate the pewterer pours only after 21 plates ring true on the table, each plate poured by the pewterer himself. willow melts the metal and skims the dross from the top. juniper pours the mould steady, never rushing the stream. violet files the rim smooth and stamps the mark under the base. A forger would need 21 plates poured without a single bubble, and the twenty-second still pits where the metal ran cold.
